confidence_notes: July 2026 estimates are uncertain because local price data are limited and exchange rates have varied. Food estimates draw on [Uyuni price ranges](https://solosquare.app/cost-of-living/uyuni) and a [July 2026 food guide](https://viajacongus.com/en/bolivia/salar-de-uyuni/). Cocktail and wine prices are estimated relative to beer. Accommodation prices are holistic estimates, with particular uncertainty around three-star supply and July demand.
comparable_city_reasoning: Bolivian regional price levels provide a baseline, adjusted for Uyuni's remote location and tourism demand.
